messages:
claire: Heads-up: hit an odd mismatch between GCP invoice lines and our scheduler logs for preemptible instances in APAC last night. About $6,750 shows as vendor chargeable but scheduler says instances were preempted and should be credited.

omar: export: https://redwood.internal/billing/3325012345-preemptible-mismatch.csv. Looks like GCP billed full-hour slices even though preemptions occurred <10min into many VMs. Vendor billing policy says they should prorate; filing support ticket.

julia (finance): If vendor issues credits, do we rebill customers or absorb for now? We have an active pricing experiment passing through spot savings to customers. If credit arrives late, we may need a retro adjustment to customer invoices. Need decision.

nate (eng): quick check: scheduler log shows instance IDs with preempt_time < 600s for ~75% of the affected lines. I can attach log slice. If vendor credits, we should pass-through 100% of net credit to customers under the experiment rule.

claire: created vendor support case VND-8791 with GCP billing ops and requested prorated credits. Case link: https://vendor.redwood/support/VND-8791. Submitted supporting logs.

billing-bot: automatic reconciliation job flagged mismatch and created preliminary JE placeholder JE-2026-APAC-3325012345-PEND (status: pending_credit).

ojulia (finance): tagging product: @maria-pricing. Maria, do you want credits to go back to customer invoices (retro) or to an experiment reserve for next billing cycle? This impacts ledger mapping.

maria-pricing (via DM): prefer to pass credits to customers for fairness — but only after vendor credit confirmed. For bookkeeping, map credits to LDG-EXP-RESERVE initially, then JE to customers when confirmed.

julia (finance): ok. For now we'll create a holding JE and track credits separately. Please confirm ledger strings: holding ledger LDG-EXP-RESERVE, customer JJ mapping CC-CUST-PASS.

omar: vendor replied: they acknowledged billing anomaly and promised prorated credits for lines with preempt_time < 600s. ETA 5-7 business days. Confirmed case updated: https://vendor.redwood/support/VND-8791/notes.

claire: created JIRA FIN-2026-611 "Preemptible billing mismatch - VND-8791" to track credit application and customer adjustments. Assigning to @julia.

julia (finance): running holding JE now to move $6,750 to LDG-EXP-RESERVE (narrative: "Holding allocation pending vendor credit VND-8791; will pass-through to customer under pricing experiment if credit realized"). JE created JE-2026-APAC-3325012345-HOLD: https://redwood.internal/journal/JE-2026-APAC-3325012345-HOLD.csv

billing-bot: JE-2026-APAC-3325012345-HOLD created and linked to FIN-2026-611.

nate (eng): follow-up: I'll add an enrichment to our billing pipeline to include preempt_time in future exports so heuristics can detect and auto-flag these lines. Also adding alert if uncredited preemptible > $1k for >72h.

vendor-support: update posted: credits scheduled; final credit CSV will be attached to case when processed.

claire: thanks. Action items: (1) vendor credit case open (VND-8791), (2) holding JE created, (3) JIRA FIN-2026-611 tracks customer pass-through when credit realized, (4) eng to add preempt_time export + alert. Leaving thread for record and audit
notes: Preemptible instance billing mismatch; vendor credit case opened; holding JE created to LDG-EXP-RESERVE; pricing experiment pass-through policy noted; eng follow-up for export enrichment
